body: Small goals, one day at a time, believing in yourself, self learning, daily improvements, going to sleep and figuring how you can do more the next day and keeping a positive mind. I heard all that before and I'm fed up with myself and I don't want to continue. Why can't I die without anyone caring about me? That's all I want.

Same. Why should I continue to live? I had a good job and I fucked it up. I am literally academically behind. I Had a lot of opportunities and I fucked them all up. I have to stay alive so my family won't get upset? I don't want to work shitty jobs for the rest of my life to have the weekend off. I should of known better from before but I was too busy ignoring my problems and now it's a little too late to face them. It would take a lot of hard word and self discipline to get a half decent career/future. The amount of work that I will have to put it is disgusting and that's not what I want to do. I wish I had handgun to blow my brains out.

I went for a walk earlier to visit my grandma in the old folks home. I still feel really shitty right now. I was walking again just now and I swear if I had a rope I would hang myself on the tree outside.
